svg.title: The credit-file stack
svg.desc: Four bands from top to bottom: application and UX (not Panini's layer), decisioning and credit policy (the lender's own), the Panini normalization band (extract, forensics, fraud suite, consolidation, conduct, income docs, report; open source), and data rails (AA, bank documents, SMS). Vendors sell the normalization band per report; Panini provides open equivalents.
